literal_meaning: খাড়া (upright), বড়ি (steps or rounds), থোড় (small amount or dribble); a repetitive cycle of upright steps and small measures, reversed
figurative_meaning_bn: চরম একঘেয়েমি; কোনো অবস্থা যখন আগে-পরে একই রকম এবং বৈচিত্র্যহীন; বিরক্তিকর পুনরাবৃত্তি
figurative_meaning_en: Extreme monotony; a situation that remains unchanged and lacks variety from beginning to end; annoying repetition
example_sentences_in_bangla: এই কাজটা খাড়া-বড়ি-থোড় হয়ে গেছে, কোনো পরিবর্তন নেই।
example_sentences_in_english: This job has become sheer monotony, with no change at all.
Life feels like annoying repetition, the same every day.
note: The idiom evokes a sense of cyclical, unchanging motion, possibly inspired by rural daily chores like grinding or stepping in place.
